instruction: The LRU cache in cache/lru.go is supposed to expire entries `ttl` after they were set, but Get() never checks the entry's expiry: a stale entry is returned as if it were fresh, and it is even promoted to most-recently-used. Fix Get() so an expired entry is treated as absent (returns \"\", false) and is removed from the cache, so Len() no longer counts it — without changing the eviction behaviour covered by TestEvictsLeastRecentlyUsed.
